name: context-mode
description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
one_liner: Stops your AI coding assistant from drowning in its own tool output and forgetting what it was doing, by quietly compressing what it reads and remembering the session for you.
buyer: An engineering team running AI coding agents all day whose sessions keep hitting context limits and losing track of what they were building mid-task.
business_use_cases: A dev team running long autonomous coding sessions installs it so the agent stops forgetting which files it was editing after a context compaction, cutting wasted re-explaining time.
An engineering org paying per-token for AI coding tools uses the 98% tool-output reduction to materially cut its monthly API bill without changing how developers work.
A consultancy running client coding engagements uses the session-continuity feature so work picks back up exactly where it left off across days, instead of re-briefing the agent each morning.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid enterprise rollout and tuning for large engineering orgs adopting it across hundreds of developers.
Build a hosted version with team-wide session dashboards and cost reporting, sold per seat.

steal_this: It's a pure developer-infrastructure cost-saver; the real weekend move is adopting it internally to cut your own team's AI bill, then publishing the before/after savings as marketing for your dev agency.
